One With the World Soul.description:
You successfully performed a ritual to bond with the spirit of the planet Akiton. While this connection has faded with time, you retain a fraction of the planet's power. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Akiton Lore (or the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} general feat for Akiton Lore, if you already have Additional Lore for Akiton Lore). Choose one common cantrip from the primal spell list.

You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} and the chosen cantrip as primal innate spells at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level, rounded up.
One With the World Soul.name: One With the World Soul

Ooranak Rescuer.description:
Requirements You rescued the ooranak pup and returned it to its home

Effect Saving the reality-stitched ooranak pup left an indelible mark upon your spirit, forever marking you as a friend to animals. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Nature checks to [[/act command-an-animal]] and on all skill checks attempted to calm down or befriend an animal.
Ooranak Rescuer.name: Ooranak Rescuer
